title: CSKGEdge v1
description: A governance-bearing CSKG edge record — the wire/record companion to WO-A's cypher-atomspace-gateway, which today carries only a bare TruthValue{strength,confidence} per edge. Distilled from the Masonmark 'Schema-Grounded KAIROS/CHRONOS CSKG' deck (slides 53-54: 'Ontology Grounding + Commonsense Priors'): commonsense knowledge (CSKG/ConceptNet-style) is DEFEASIBLE SUPPORT, never institutional truth. This schema projects three estate disciplines that already exist elsewhere onto the graph EDGE so the gateway can consume them: (1) the epistemic-authority ladder (artifact-registry E1-E5 / fibration-node ceiling) as a per-edge tier + defeasibility law; (2) provenance (public CSKG source/sentence qualifiers, dropped by the gateway fixture) restored on the edge; (3) the estate three-time model (metadata-intake temporal: txn/valid/observed) — the edge carries ONLY valid-time + observation-time; transaction/system-time stays on the record/ledger, so no separate 'Kairos/Chronos' clock is introduced.

edgeId.description: Stable edge id (public CSKG `id` column analogue).

relation.description: Edge predicate (public CSKG `relation`; EvaluationLink predicate, e.g. IsA/Causes).

lifted.description: Optional public-CSKG lifted columns (node1;label, node2;label, relation;label, relation;dimension).

truth.description: The gateway's TruthValue (adapter.py). Composes multiplicatively along a path (v0).

epistemicTier.description: Authority tier (deck slide 54's three layers). institutional = authoritative estate truth; schema = curated governed-schema fact; commonsense = CSKG/ConceptNet defeasible prior.

defeasible.description: Whether the edge may be overridden. LAW: commonsense => true (never authoritative); institutional => false (authoritative). Enforced cross-field by the validator (CE-T1/CE-T2).

status.description: Controlled KB-extension state: candidate = reviewable cairnmark (predicted/discovered); promoted = adjudicated Stele; tombstoned = logically deleted (aligns cskg.vnext DeleteEdge).

provenance.description: Public CSKG source/sentence qualifiers, restored on the edge. REQUIRED for institutional & schema tiers (provenance-complete by construction; CE-T3).

source.description: Source dataset/document/governed id (not a raw string).

temporal.description: Edge-level temporal typing, REUSING the metadata-intake three-time vocabulary. The edge carries valid-time + observation-time ONLY. Transaction/system-time (txn_created) is deliberately NOT accepted here — it belongs to the record/ledger (metadata-record + proof-artifact spine). additionalProperties:false makes 'no txn clock on the edge' mechanical (CE-T7).

validFromMicros.description: Valid-time start: when the fact begins to hold in the world.

validToMicros.description: Valid-time end: when the fact ceases to hold (null = open).

observedAtMicros.description: Observation/event-time: when the edge was observed or extracted.
